# A top-level func that writes a top-level var compiles, and the write lands.
#
# This is the CLI's harness rather than a golden because the claim is that the
# generated Go *compiles and runs*; testdata/toplevel_func_reads_state.txtar
# holds the shape it comes out in.

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

var log string = ""

func bump(k int) int {
    log = log + "!"
    return k * 2
}

func viaBump(a int) => bump(a) + 1

component main node {
    var out = 0
    var note = ""

    effect(@mount {
        out = viaBump(3)
        note = log
    })

    text(value="{out}{note}")
}

func testTopLevelFuncWritesTopLevelVar(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.out == 7)
    t.assert(c.note == "!")
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --
sha256:db0e5dc44f3e3770c147a728e4639667
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "TopLevelFuncWritesTopLevelVar",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
